From 92436305b663039485ced5c38a9c12c4ed2e0851 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Olivier Moysan <olivier.moysan@foss.st.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2024 13:59:12 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] dt-bindings: iio: stm32: dfsdm: fix dtbs warnings on dfsdm
 audio port

Fix warnings on DFSDM dtbs check
Unevaluated properties are not allowed ('dfsdm-dai' was unexpected)
'port' does not match any of the regexes: 'pinctrl-[0-9]+'

Fixes: 11183ac07a74 ("dt-bindings: stm32: convert dfsdm to json-schema")
Signed-off-by: Olivier Moysan <olivier.moysan@foss.st.com>
Acked-by: Rob Herring (Arm) <robh@kernel.org>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20240618115912.706912-1-olivier.moysan@foss.st.com
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/iio/adc/st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/iio/adc/st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml
index c1b1324fa132..2722edab1d9a 100644
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/iio/adc/st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/iio/adc/st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml
@@ -246,6 +246,10 @@ patternProperties:
                     From common IIO binding. Used to pipe external sigma delta
                     modulator or internal ADC output to DFSDM channel.
 
+                port:
+                  $ref: /schemas/sound/audio-graph-port.yaml#
+                  unevaluatedProperties: false
+
               required:
                 - compatible
                 - "#sound-dai-cells"
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml`**
   - Added a new property `port` which references the schema located at `/schemas/sound/audio-graph-port.yaml#`.
   - Set the `unevaluatedProperties` attribute to `false` for the `port` property.

### Relationships
The modifications in the `st,stm32-dfsdm-adc.yaml` file address specific warnings related to device tree bindings. By adding the `port` property and restricting unevaluated properties, the patch resolves issues where unexpected properties were causing warnings during device tree binary (dtbs) checks. This change ensures compliance with the expected schema, thereby fixing the warnings associated with the DFSDM audio port configuration.

The bug was caused by the presence of unexpected properties in the device tree bindings for the DFSDM audio port, specifically the 'dfsdm-dai' property, and the 'port' property not matching the required regex pattern for pin control properties.
